pins.title: Give them a year of hiking goals
pins.sub: Planner, peak logbook and parks tracker.
pins.pinTitle: 2027 hiking goals gift set: printable year planner, peak logbook and parks tracker
pins.description: A gift for the hiker already making plans for next year: the 2027 Hiking Year Planner with the hike-a-week challenge, the Peak Bagger's Logbook and the US National Parks Tracker. Three printables in one instant download, so you can give it the same day.

pins.title: Cold wooden floors? Wear merino.
pins.sub: Warm socks for home, not only hikes.
pins.pinTitle: Merino wool socks for cold floors at home: soft, warm crew socks for the whole winter
pins.description: Cold floors in the morning and drafty rooms at night: a cushioned merino wool crew sock (80% merino) keeps feet warm at home and stays comfortable all day. Four colours, and they work just as well for walks, work and travel.

pins.title: On your feet all day?
pins.sub: Cushioned merino for work and travel.
pins.pinTitle: Cushioned merino wool socks for long days on your feet: work shifts, commute and travel
pins.description: Long shifts, the commute, a day of airports: our merino wool crew socks (80% merino) have a cushioned sole, and merino stays comfortable in cold and warm rooms and resists odor, so one pair lasts the whole day.

pins.title: Headlamp dying in the cold?
pins.sub: Keep the battery warm. Here is how.
pins.pinTitle: Why your headlamp dies in the cold, and how to keep it working on a winter hike
pins.description: Cold slows the chemistry inside a battery, so a headlamp dims or shuts off early even when the charge is still there. Keep the light or spare battery in an inside pocket, know which batteries handle cold best, and never charge a frozen battery.

pins.title: Phone dying on cold hikes?
pins.sub: Keep it in an inside pocket.
pins.pinTitle: How to keep your phone warm and charged on a cold hike: inside pocket and power bank
pins.description: Phones drain fast in the cold, but it is usually temporary. Start at 100%, keep the phone in an inside pocket close to your body, use airplane mode with an offline map and carry a power bank that you keep warm too.

pins.title: Hiking with a baby or toddler?
pins.pinTitle: Hiking with babies and toddlers printable guide: carrier tips and packing checklist
pins.description: For parents who want to keep hiking with a little one up to about age 4: picking a first family trail, carrier types by age, what to pack, dressing a baby for cold days, naps and diapers on the trail, and when to turn around. Instant PDF with checklists.

pins.title: Trekking poles slipping?
pins.pinTitle: How to stop trekking poles from slipping: fix twist locks and lever locks before a descent
pins.description: Most slipping trekking poles are not broken: they are dirty, wet, set past their limit, or the lock needs a small adjustment. How to fix twist locks and lever locks, a one-minute check before every descent, and when to replace the pole.

pins.title: Rocky Mountain National Park, planned
pins.sub: Day hikes, timed entry and 3-day plans.
pins.board: Best Day Hikes in US National Parks
pins.pinTitle: Rocky Mountain National Park trip planner printable: 18 day hikes and 1-3 day plans
pins.description: A printable trip planner for first-time visitors to Rocky Mountain National Park: when to go, timed entry explained, 18 day hikes from lakeside loops to waterfalls, altitude and storm safety, and sample 1, 2 and 3-day plans. Check nps.gov/romo for next season's dates.

pins.title: Ready for your first winter hike?
pins.pinTitle: Winter hiking guide and cold weather checklist printable: layers, short days and icy trails
pins.description: A printable guide for winter day hikes: how to layer from base to shell, planning around short daylight, when you need microspikes, and the cold-weather warning signs. Includes a winter day-hike checklist and a layering chart in °F and °C.

pins.title: Utah's Mighty 5 in one road trip
pins.pinTitle: Utah Mighty 5 road trip planner: 3, 5 and 7 day itineraries plus 10 best day hikes as GPX
pins.description: Plan a Utah national parks road trip through Zion, Bryce Canyon, Capitol Reef, Canyonlands and Arches: seasons, fees, where to stay, 3, 5 and 7-day itineraries, plus GPX routes for 10 classic day hikes like Delicate Arch and the Navajo Loop. Instant download.
